<div class="card-body">
'''Lightsaber Proficiency''' is a [[Light]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ライトセーバー修得</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">能力値＞2でライトセーバーを持つキャラクターに配備する。キャラクターは、戦闘力が＋3され、いるロケーションのフォース消耗に＋1される。キャラクターがライトセーバーをなくせば、このエフェクトはロストする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-54o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ジェダイが学ぶのは、ただライトセーバーを振るうだけでなく、フォースを通わせて技を磨き、セーバーの威力を制御することである。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Lightsaber Proficiency.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on a character of ability > 2 who has a lightsaber. That character is power +3 and Force drain +1 where present. Lost if that character loses the lightsaber.

'''Lore:''' A Jedi learns more than how to swing a lightsaber. The Force hones the skill and controls the blade.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese adds power +3 and Force drain +1; the English is power +3 in battles or Force drain +1.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Lightsaber Proficiency]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
